summary: The Bring-Your-Own Meta App feature (Model B with Model A fallback) is implemented correctly and completely against the approved design, requirements, and plan. All ten acceptance criteria are met and verified by reading the full diff on main (4 commits over origin/main) plus the recorded FEAT evidence. The TenantMetaApp model is added with cuid id, userId @unique, metaAppId/metaAppSecret/configId?, createdAt @default(now()), updatedAt @updatedAt, and a User.tenantMetaApp back-relation with onDelete: Cascade; the idempotent @libsql/client migration script creates the table with CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS, no FOREIGN KEY, no DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, and FEAT-001 records a real run-1-created / run-2-clean-no-op against live Turso with PRAGMA-confirmed columns and the TenantMetaApp_userId_key unique index. resolveMetaAppCredentials implements the exact tenant->platform precedence with clean MetaAppConfigError on bad decrypt and missing platform env, never logging or returning ciphertext. Embedded-signup resolves creds via the resolver, mapping MetaAppConfigError to the unchanged 500 copy and rethrowing other errors to the existing top-level catch. The webhook implements the §4 load-bearing order exactly: signature-header gate before any parse or DB, <=10 candidate id cap, bounded candidate-secret set, undecryptable candidates skipped silently, fail-closed when secrets.size===0 or no match, no secrets logged, and the intended Model-B behavior change honored; the GET handshake and processing loop are unchanged. /api/meta-app GET/PUT/DELETE is session-guarded and userId-scoped, never leaks the secret value (serializeMetaApp never selects/decrypts the ciphertext; hasSecret means stored), uses an atomic upsert with required-on-create secret and configId null-clears/omit-keeps, DELETE is idempotent, and all methods 401 without a session with no console.* calls. The settings page shows the write-only never-pre-filled secret with the 'Secret is stored' copy, source badge, null-clear logic, and inline (non-redirecting) error handling; the connect page fetches effective config at runtime, keeps the verbatim not-configured message, gates FB init on cfg.appId, and leaves the manual form gated only on showManual. .env.example reframes the platform vars as the Model A fallback, replaces the stale 'only ever read client-side' claim with build-time-inlined-AND-server-side wording, softens the rebuild caveat, and corrects the footer, with no new env var. scratchpad.md is refreshed (Last updated 2026-10-15) with the schema, resolver, endpoints, webhook flow, env semantics, UI pages, and a dated change-log entry. npm run build (prisma generate && next build) completes with exit 0 and 'Compiled successfully'; the pre-existing 'Dynamic server usage' messages are on unrelated dynamic routes and are not errors. No new runtime dependency was added and send paths, template routes, manual connect, and serializeNumber are untouched (no regression).
